title: Concept: Git dependency pinned to a short commit fragment
description: package.json declares a git dependency pinned to a commit fragment rather than a registry version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The commit is immutable but outside the registry, so no registry attestation, signature or advisory range covers the code that runs.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The commit is immutable but outside the registry, so no registry attestation, signature or advisory range covers the code that runs.
